Hi Lily — thanks for the heads up and for attaching the change notice.

Couple quick asks before I can instruct payments from our AP team:
- Can you confirm that the legal payee name on the invoice matches the bank account entity (SeedPay Ops LLC)? Our accounting requires exact match for ACH reconciliation.
- Can you upload the W-9 to our secure intake link (https://app.redwood.com/secure/upload/seedpay-w9) or reply with the portal reference? You mentioned it was uploaded on your portal; we don't have direct access there.
- For a routing verification on your side, can you provide the last 4 digits of the account we should expect? We use that as a quick tie-out.

If ACH is validated we will prefer ACH (lower fees). If onboarding the new bank will cause delays beyond 3 business days, we can process a wire for this single invoice — wire will require a bank confirmation letter or the BankChange_Notice (which you attached) plus an internal approval.

I can commit to getting this routed to AP by end of day tomorrow if you can confirm the payee name matches and provide the W-9 reference or the last 4 digits. Otherwise I will escalate to Kimberly for an exception to do wire.

Thanks,
